verdict.rationale: pnpm docs explicitly advertise 'filtering to run tasks on just the projects you touched' as a first-class monorepo feature, and community evidence corroborates that pnpm's built-in monorepo/workspace support (including filtered scripts/installs) works well in practice. Missing for 10: no explicit doc excerpt showing '--filter ...[changed]' change-detection syntax details, and no independent hands-on verification of filter-affected-only workflows specifically.
